name: ax-narrate
description: Write the agent-generated narration of the current session - the reviewable story of what changed, including what never reaches a PR (user corrections, abandoned attempts, tool failures). Triggers on "narrate this session", "summarize what changed", "write the session story", "narrate what we did", "session narration". Output is .ax/narrations/<session-id>.json for the ax studio narration view. Do NOT fire on "summarize this file" or generic recap questions answered inline - this skill writes a
author: Necmttn
summary_zh: 将开发会话整理成可审阅的变更故事，记录用户纠正、放弃尝试和工具失败，适合复盘未进入 PR 的过程。
